about-us.html: September, 2021, Spring Branch residents welcomed the Devine Wine Bar Restaurant, in the well-known Faithville Park boutique-style shopping center, located on Highway 46 West.

Matthew and Tina Zillmann, who have owned and operated Skin Rejuvenation Clinics since 1991, opened their third clinic location in Faithville Park back in 2016. “We love the location. It is so quaint and charming. I have always dreamed of opening a wine bar, so Faithville seemed like the perfect place to do it.” said Tina Zillmann.

The Zillmanns opened Devine Wine Bar Restaurant on September 18, 2021 in the previous Copelli’s Coffee location. Due to our popularity, on December 1, 2023 we relocated to a new, larger location, (previously Jalisco’s Restaurant) still within Faithville Park. Devine Wine Bar Restaurant offers a variety of wine, craft cocktails, beer, gourmet coffee, delicious food, homemade desserts, and unique giftables. House and Featured Wines are available in “flights” so you can experience several new tastes in one visit. “We try to focus on local products, and farm-to-table specialties.” said Matt Zillmann. “There is nothing quite like this in the area, so we are very excited to give residents of Spring Branch, and visitors alike, a unique restaurant to gather and reconnect in a casual, yet elegant setting.”
Devine Wine Bar Restaurant has a great atmosphere with a large outdoor patio. Sign up for our weekly newsletter or like us on facebook to see weekly specials, upcoming live music, and special events.

Having a Party? Devine Wine Bar Restaurant is also a perfect venue for private events. Our new, larger location comes complete with a private party room to make every event extra special. Ask us about private events, party packages, and off-site catering.

At Devine Wine Bar & Bistro, our mission is to bring people together through exceptional food, great wine, handcrafted cocktails, live music, and genuine hospitality. What started as a love for wine and tapas has evolved into a destination where friends gather, families celebrate, and memories are made. We are passionate about serving comfort food with a fresh, healthy twist, creating dishes that are both satisfying and thoughtfully prepared.

As local owners, Jarrett and Kendal are deeply committed to the community they grew up in. Their vision is to create more than a restaurant—they strive to provide a welcoming place where guests can connect, celebrate life’s milestones, and enjoy meaningful moments together.

Whether you join us for brunch, lunch, dinner, a special event, off-site catering, or take home one of our favorite prepared meals, our commitment remains the same: to provide outstanding food, warm hospitality, and experiences that leave lasting memories.
GOOD FOOD. GREAT WINE. CRAFT COCKTAILS. GOOD FRIENDS.
At Devine Wine Bar & Bistro, we believe the best moments in life are shared around the table, and we are honored to be part of your story.
The Zillmann Family. Left to right: Jarrett, Tina, Matthew and Morgan

Max Capacity is 25. Reservations are Highly Recommended.
An Exclusive New Experience at Devine

Behind an unmarked door and beneath the glow of amber light, the evening slows to a velvet hush. Devine Speakeasy Lounge is more than a place to gather — it’s an escape into another era, where decadent vintages and handcrafted cocktails linger on the palate, live music drifts through the air, and every corner feels wrapped in mystery.

Sink into the warmth of a dark, intimate setting filled with rich textures, candlelit tables, and the soft hum of conversation. Savor elevated cuisine, expertly mixed drinks, and soulful performances that turn an ordinary night into something unforgettable.
Whether hidden away for a quiet rendezvous or celebrating with friends, Devine Speakeasy Lounge invites you to indulge, unwind, and stay a little longer. Step inside. The night is waiting.
